researcher_status.plain_language_title: This version of the runner works with synthetic data only
researcher_status.plain_language_summary: The analysis plan describes the data as 'REAL'. This runner is approved for synthetic (made-up) data only.
researcher_status.why_it_matters: Real participant data may only be processed once ethics approval, data-custodian authority, an approved processing location and a confirmed research plan are all in place and verified.
researcher_status.next_action: Continue using synthetic data for development and testing. Real-data execution is a separate, human-approved step.
researcher_status.resolving_role: The ethics or data-governance contact for the study.
